```{r}
if (!is.null(params$table_file) && file.exists(params$table_file)) {
  descriptives_table <- readRDS(params$table_file)
} else {
  targets_store <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "_targets" else file.path("..", "_targets")
  descriptives_table <- targets::tar_read(
    descriptives_table,
    store = targets_store
  )
}

if (inherits(descriptives_table, "flextable") &&
    !requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The flextable package is required to render the descriptives table.")
}
```

The table summarises the baseline characteristics of every eligible study arm, including the four Greek studies retained for sensitivity analysis. Scroll horizontally to view all columns on smaller screens.

::: {.table-responsive}
```{r}
if (inherits(descriptives_table, "flextable")) {
  descriptives_table
} else {
  knitr::kable(
    descriptives_table,
    format = "html",
    table.attr = "class=\"table table-striped table-hover table-sm\""
  )
}
```
